newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate eases, baht falls late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate eases, baht falls late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate fell to 11.50-12.00 percent in late trade on Wednesday from 12.00 percent earlier as a result of the Bank of Thailand's continuing fund injection into the system, dealers said.

The central bank governor said on Wednesday the central bank injected a total of 10 billion baht into the system in the morning. The BOT injected 49.4 billion baht into the market between September 5-9.
The baht fell sharply to 25.385-25.390 to the dollar late from 25.372-25.375 earlier and 25.354-25.359 late on Tuesday on the dollar's surge abroad, dealers said.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium declined to 9.25/9.80 satangs per a dollar late from 10.00/11.00 in early morning.
The mid-rate was fixed unchanged at 25.37 to the dollar against 25.34 on Tuesday. Wednesday's mid-rate was the lowest since July 15 when the mid-rate was at 25.39.
